shortText: GR lot 010000004004: chromium below 12.0 %, Nordstahl Edelstahl GmbH
rootCause: Mix-up at the mill: one bundle from a lower-chromium heat was tagged with the 4Cr13 heat number.
longText: Spark OES check of batch B2603-004: CR_PCT mean 11.82 % (sample range 11.74 to 11.9), limits 12 to 14. Mill certificate showed 13.1 % Cr, so the certificate did not match the material. Whole bundle returned. Mill added a PMI check before tagging.

defectText: Hardness above specification after heat treatment
shortText: GR lot 010000004051: HV10 out of spec, Härterei Weser GmbH
rootCause: Tempering furnace TO-3 thermocouple drift at Härterei Weser: furnace read about 40 °C high, so parts were tempered below set point (under-tempered martensite, high hardness, low toughness).
longText: Goods receipt inspection of batch B2607-034 from Härterei Weser GmbH. HV10 mean 658 HV10 (sample range 649 to 668), limits 450 to 650. Bending force also low, fracture surfaces bright and flat (brittle). Lot blocked and returned to vendor. Supplier informed, 8D requested. Containment: 100% HV10 check on stock and WIP of AX-4CR13-080.

shortText: Customer 0002100 (window-lift drives): 3 axles cracked at end-of-line test
rootCause: Part of heat-treat batch B2608-041 was under-tempered (thermocouple drift at Härterei Weser furnace TO-3). The 5 sampled parts came from a correctly tempered basket, so the lot passed goods receipt.
longText: Customer end-of-line test found 3 cracked axles at the shaft shoulder. Lab: HV10 671, 668, 675. SEM fractography: flat cleavage facets, no dimples, so brittle fracture. Containment: customer stock sorted, 100% HV10 at our goods receipt for 6 lots. 8D with Härterei Weser: thermocouple replaced 2026-08-20, temper temperature now logged with SPC, second independent thermocouple added, verification lots after 2026-08-24 all within 450 to 650 HV10.

defectText: Sampling plan not tightened after first HV10 reject
shortText: Internal: GR sampling stayed at 5 parts after first HV10 rejection
rootCause: Control plan reaction step (switch to tightened inspection after a rejected lot) was not linked to the inspection plan in QM.
longText: After the first HV10 rejection in July, sampling stayed at 5 parts per lot, which let batch B2608-041 pass. Action: dynamic modification rule added so the next 5 lots after a rejection use tightened inspection.

shortText: Housings scratched in transport, KLT separator missing
longText: 40 housings in batch B2609-033 scratched on the sealing face because KLT separators were missing. Parts sorted, sealing face OK on 1160 parts. Supplier asked to confirm packaging instruction.
